messages:
maya: Quick follow-up on RFC #12. Proposing a host-side sidecar pattern as a lower-risk first step before splitting the enrichment-service. Plan below.

jordan: Sounds reasonable. TL;DR of the cutover steps?

maya: TL;DR: build sidecar + shim, deploy to staging disabled, pre-warm caches, flip small percent of reads to sidecar, monitor gates, roll further or extract later.

sahil: Obs: add span tag `enricher.path` and `cache.evictions`. Also expose /metrics and a healthcheck for fast fallback.

becka: Product must sign off. Need p99 delta <= baseline +20ms and error_rate <0.25% for paid regions. Notify top customers.

oliver: Rollout sketch:
- host canary: 2 hosts 20m
- region gradual: 5% 1h
- full: 24h
Gates: p95, p99, error_rate, tail-cache-miss.

jordan: Memory cap needed. Sidecar must support --cache-size-mb and eviction policy (2Q/LRU).

sahil: Add chaos test: kill sidecar process; shim must fallback to remote read-service within 10ms. I'll script that.

maya: Prewarm: prefetch recent hot keys with priority queue; prioritize recent and high-frequency keys.

becka: Support standby required for first prod promotion. We'll prepare comms and a rollback playbook.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: branch/feature/sidecar -> staging at 2023-11-09T15:30Z

maya: Owners: jordan(packaging + prefetch), sahil(obs + tests), becka(SLA + comms), oliver(rollout + demo), maya(coord). I'll open a runbook PR and post here.

jordan: starting packaging spike, will post build artifact link when ready.

maya: Thanks — keeping this thread as canonical playbook for sidecar-first migration.
